class.name: EffectSpawner3D
class.brief_description: Plays another particle effect or creates a scene at its position, for example gibs or a secondary explosion.
class.description: When [method spawn] is called, [member scene] is created [member count] times at this node's global transform, each one moved by a random offset within [member scatter_radius]. A scene whose root is a [ParticleEffect3D] is played through [method ParticleEffect3D.spawn], so it comes from the effect pool and counts against the effect budget. With [member inherit_look] it takes the tint and scale its parent effect plays with. Any other scene is instantiated under the parent of the effect. With [member launch_speed] above zero, a [RigidBody3D] root (or a root with a [code]velocity[/code] property) is thrown along this node's +Y axis inside a cone of [member launch_spread] degrees. As a child of a [ParticleEffect3D], it fires automatically at its start time (see [method ParticleEffect3D.set_emitter_delay]). In the editor only particle effects are shown, from the moment the event fires; other scenes need the running game.

method.name: spawn
method.description: Spawns [member scene] now. Inside a [ParticleEffect3D] the new nodes are added next to that effect, otherwise next to this node.

members.member: How many copies of [member scene] one [method spawn] creates.
If [code]true[/code], a spawned particle effect is played with the tint and scale of the effect this node belongs to.
Speed in meters per second at which a spawned scene (not a particle effect) is thrown along this node's +Y axis. [code]0[/code] leaves it at rest.
Half angle in degrees of the cone the launch direction is picked from.
Each copy is placed at a random point within this distance of the node.
The particle effect or scene to spawn.
